Where these listings come from

Read on 2026-10-30. Fees are not listed: they change every year and are published by each state's counselling authority. NEET coaching covers the brands whose centre lists we could read; many local institutes are not listed yet.

  1. National Medical Commission — list of colleges teaching MBBS (opens in a new tab) 834 colleges with 2026-27 approved MBBS seats, read 2026-10-30.
  2. Institute websites (AIIMS, JIPMER and other Institutes of National Importance) (opens in a new tab) Not on the NMC list; each checked on its own website.
  3. Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) — All India Quota counselling (opens in a new tab) How the 15% All India Quota, deemed and central seats are filled.
  4. Coaching brands' official centre locators and branch pages Each NEET centre links to its own branch page or the brand's official list of centres.
